patterns.note: Content is presented in full-width sections with centered, constrained-width content blocks, creating a clear visual hierarchy and focus.
Section headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for strong impact, contrasted with a lighter weight, highly readable sans-serif for body text and descriptions.
A dominant deep blue is used for primary calls-to-action and the initial navigation bar, providing a strong brand accent against a clean white background.
The navigation bar transforms upon scroll, changing from a dark blue background with a white logo to a white background with a dark logo and a subtle shadow, indicating its sticky state.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect, where the background image of the house and landscape scrolls slower than the overlaying text and interactive elements, adding depth.
Content sections below the hero reveal with a gentle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling, enhancing engagement.
Extensive use of detailed 3D architectural renders and clean line-art illustrations to visually represent different home models, floor plans, and ADUs.

technique_notes: The sticky navigation bar dynamically changes its background color, logo color, and adds a subtle drop shadow when the user scrolls past the initial hero section, providing a clear visual cue of its fixed position.

The hero section employs a parallax scrolling effect where the background image moves at a slower rate than the foreground text and interactive elements, creating a sense of depth and visual interest.

Content sections are revealed using scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations, causing them to subtly fade and slide into view from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport, guiding the user's attention.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a clean, readable sans-serif body font.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and interactive input elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy in the hero section, transitioning to a more structured and slightly denser layout for content sections with clear vertical rhythm.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its sophisticated integration of high-quality 3D architectural renders and clean line-art illustrations to visually articulate its product offerings. This, combined with an interactive hero section featuring immediate filtering options, elevates the user experience beyond typical real estate or home-building sites.
